findings.claim: Nikkei 報導 Toshiba 計畫 HDD 產能於 FY2027 前約倍增，容量份額目標由約 10% 拉到 30%；報導後 2026-10-02 WDC 約跌 10%、STX 約跌 15%，Fool 文章並指 Toshiba 可能以低價搶單壓縮 WD 毛利
findings.source: Motley Fool, Why Western Digital Stock Just Crashed
findings.excerpt: Toshiba aims to lift its HDD share by storage capacity from just over 10% to 30% over the medium term, according to Nikkei.

findings.claim: 2026 年 8 月報導 HDD 份額：WD 約 42%、Seagate 41%、Toshiba 17%（未見 2026 年 WD 增減份額的季度序列）
findings.source: Motley Fool / 搜尋彙整 (2026-08 report)
findings.excerpt: In terms of HDD market share, WD currently represents approximately 42% of the market, followed closely by Seagate at 41% and Toshiba at 17%.

findings.claim: HAMR 進度：Seagate 已有兩家大型 hyperscaler 量產採購 Mozaic 4+；WDC 預計 2026 上半年與一家 hyperscaler 開始認證、年底擴至最多三家，量產爬坡 2027 上半年（3dnews 另稱 2026 年底開始 HAMR 生產，時間不一致）
findings.source: Nasdaq/Zacks, Seagate vs. Western Digital: Which Storage Stock is the Better Buy Now?
findings.excerpt: WDC remains on track to begin qualification with one hyperscale customer in the first half of 2026, expanding to up to three customers by year-end.

findings.claim: Coughlin 2025 Q1 資料：WD 單位份額 42%（179.8 EB）、Seagate 40%、Toshiba 18%，WD 自 Toshiba 取得約 1 點份額
findings.excerpt: Western Digital at 179.8 EB and 42% of unit share, Seagate at 143.6 EB and 40%, and Toshiba at 41 EB and 18%.

findings.claim: 長期替代風險為 flash（SanDisk、Samsung、Micron、Kioxia）；未找到具名的 HDD 新進入者；WD 已把 SSD 業務分出，專注 HDD
findings.source: Seeking Alpha, Western Digital: Watch For Technological Threats Following Post-Earnings Sell-Off

competitive_share_entrants.note: as_of 中 2025-06-01、2026-08-31、2026-08-01 為依來源脈絡的近似日期，原頁日期未逐頁確認；excerpt 取自搜尋工具回傳摘要，非 WebFetch 全頁。
